Name: Neptune's Glaive Revamped (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=5]General[/size][/b]
I've always felt like Neptune's Glaive deserved to be more powerful than what it is in vanilla, to make it a more exciting find later in the game.
This mod makes configurable changes to this sword to make it a more powerful and desirable drop.

[b]Adding this mod to an existing save[/b]
If you have already obtained Neptune's Glaive in your save, the stats changes won't apply to your existing sword - only retextures apply to existing swords. If you obtain another one, all changes made by this mod will apply. You can delete your old sword and spawn in a new one if you want to upgrade.


[b][size=5]Configurations[/size][/b]

You can configure the sword's stats and appearance through Generic Mod Config Menu. The configuration options are as follows:

[size=3][b]Damage (default 'powerful')[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]'Default' (18-35) - vanilla. Strong (50-70) - a good weapon, but less powerful than the galaxy sword.
[*]'Powerful' (70-90) - more powerful than the galaxy swords, but less powerful than the infinity blade.
[*]'Incredible' (100-120) - more powerful than the infinity blade, but still within reason.
[*]'Unprecedented' (250-500) - unreasonably powerful.
[/list]
[size=3][b]MagicProjectiles (default 'none')
[/b][/size]Adds blue magic projectiles that are cast from the sword when used to deal damage to enemies.
[list]
[*]'none' - no projectiles cast.
[*]'weak' - projectiles dealing 10 damage to enemies.
[*]'medium' - projectiles dealing 25 damage to enemies.
[*]'strong' - projectiles dealing 50 damage to enemies.
[*]'powerful' - projectiles dealing 75 damage to enemies.
[*]'extreme' - projectiles dealing 100 damage to enemies.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Properties (default 'medium')[/size][/b]
Alters the speed, defense and crit chance of the sword.
[list]
[*]'default' - the vanilla properties.
[*]'medium' - speed 0, defense 3, crit chance .02
[*]'strong'  - speed 2, defense 4, crit chance .025
[*]'powerful'  - speed 4, defense 5, crit chance .03
[/list]
[b][size=3]Texture (default 'default')[/size][/b]
These texture options can be viewed in the images tab of this mod page.
[list]
[*]'default' - doesn't change the texture. If you have a retexture/recolor mod installed, it will apply, otherwise, the vanilla texture is used.
[*]1 - Adds a glow inside of the blade's texture.
[*]2 - Adds a glow inside and along the edges of the texture.
[*]3 - Adds seaweed to the sword.
[*]4 - Adds seaweed to the swords and makes the handle slightly lighter.
[*]5 - Option 1 with seaweed.
[*]6 - Option 2 with seaweed.
[/list]
Enjoy!
